{{Quote|Look at the Atrisi system, for example. The principal planet still recalls the Kitel Phard Dynasty with pride.|Major Arhul Hextrophon|<ref name="IS2" />}}
The '''Atrisi system''', or the '''Atrisian system''', was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] known as the [[Atrisian Commonwealth/Legends|Atrisian Commonwealth]]. It lay on the [[Giju Run/Legends|Giju Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisia]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a race of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] known as [[Atrisian]]s. Atrisia was unified by the [[Atrisian Empire]] under the leadership of the [[Kitel Phard Dynasty]]. The inhabitants of the Atrisi [[Star system/Legends|system]] subsequently held the dynasty in high regard, and the planet was alternatively referred to as "Kitel Phard."

At some point, the [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] parameter known as the [[FD number]] saw prominent use in the Atrisi system. Following the development of interstellar spaceflight by the Atrisians, their home system became a part of the Atrisian Commonwealth, and later a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and its successors, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and eventually, [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
The Atrisi [[Star system/Legends|system]],<ref name="IS2" /> also referred to as the Atrisian system,<ref name="DB">{{DB|organization|theempire|Empire, the}}</ref> was located in the [[Atrisian Commonwealth/Legends|Atrisian Commonwealth]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> The principal [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the Atrisi system was the terrestrial [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisia]],<ref name="IS2" /> also known as Kitel Phard.<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Star/Legends|star]] system lay at the endpoint of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Giju Run/Legends|Giju Run]], which, after a short detour through the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], connected it to the Core Worlds' [[Dahrtag system/Legends|Dahrtag system]].<ref name="TEA" /> Additionally, a set of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes led beyond the Atrisi system, connecting it to a tangle of stars, and ultimately, the astronomical object [[Irkalla]]<ref name="EGTW" /> in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EAOC Irkalla">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Irkalla system/Legends|Irkalla system]]</ref>

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|At the end of the march, the youths assembled at the North Garden. There, brigade leader Nenevanth Tion ''[&hellip;]'' recited a speech from the Kitel Phard Dynasty of the Atrisi system.|Republic HoloNet News report|<ref name="RHNN">{{InsiderCite|70|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:9:04}}</ref>}}
[[File:AtrisianCommonwealth-TEA.png|thumb|left|300px|The Atrisi system eventually became a part of the Atrisian Commonwealth.]]
At some point, the [[Atrisian|inhabitants]] of Atrisia established a pre-spaceflight civilization on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]<ref name="TEA" /> that consisted of several nations on multiple continents.<ref name="IS2" /> The [[Atrisian Empire]],<ref name="Files">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref> under the leadership of the [[Kitel Phard Dynasty]], eventually unified Atrisia. The inhabitants of the planet honored the dynasty for a long [[Time/Legends|time]] to come,<ref name="IS2" /> and Atrisia was subsequently given its alternate name "Kitel Phard."<ref name="TEA" />

The Atrisians eventually traveled beyond their home planet, which became one of the approximately 200 [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] worlds known as the Atrisian Commonwealth. The area of space surrounding the Atrisi system was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at some point between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] and [[3996 BBY]] and thus became part of what was considered the civilized [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Contact with the independent Atrisian Commonwealth led to the growth of the Southern Core, a region of the Core Worlds and the Colonies.<ref name="TEA" />

===Part of the wider galaxy===
{{Quote|The FD number system rose to prominence in the Artisian ''[sic]'' system ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki />|An Imperial document included in a report by Major Arhul Hextrophon|<ref name="IS2" />}}
[[File:CoreWorldsSecurityZone-TEA.png|thumb|right|300px|By 137 ABY, the Atrisi system was a part of the Core Worlds Security Zone.]]
Although space surrounding the Atrisi system was a part of the territories either unaligned with or contested by the Republic or the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], Atrisia fell within the borders of the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the first campaigns of that conflict, the [[Twentieth Army]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] was tasked with defending Atrisia's vicinity against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Shortly after the acquisition of the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during the Clone Wars, the Atrisi system was featured on a [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref> The Kitel Phard Dynasty of the Atrisi system was also mentioned in a [[HoloNet News/Legends|Republic HoloNet News]] report on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[21 BBY/Legends|14:9:04]].<ref name="RHNN" />

Atrisia lay within space controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW" /> and at some point by the time the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] took place, the use of the [[FD number]], a parameter characterizing the combat performance of military [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]], rose to prominence in the Atrisi system. The star system was mentioned by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] in a compilation of Imperial documents for Alliance [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and other Rebel [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="IS2" />

Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Atrisia declared its independence from the Empire, and the Atrisian Commonwealth eventually joined the Empire's successor government, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], as an [[Allied Region]]. By [[137 ABY]], the Atrisi system had been incorporated into the [[Core Worlds Security Zone]], an administrative territory of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Atrisia,<ref name="TEA" /> the principal planet of the Atrisi system,<ref name="IS2" /> was colonized by [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="TEA" /> who were generally thought to have evolved on the Core Worlds planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Despite eventually achieving interstellar spaceflight, the Atrisians remained an insular culture, although some left their homeworld for the wider galaxy,<ref name="TEA" /> such as [[Rom Mohc]],<ref name="Written">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref> who served with the Republic Military during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref> The population of the Atrisi system around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered from 100 million to 500 million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Atrisia's antiquity and apparent importance to galactic culture argued for putting it in the Core Worlds; we stuck it out on the frontier to give it more of a whiff of the exotic and in hopes that future Star Wars creators might find intriguing possibilities in that.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Blog">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/08/endnotes-for-star-wars-essential-atlas_24.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 2 of 5)}}</ref>}}
[[File:Impsourcebook.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Atrisi system was first mentioned in the ''Imperial Sourcebook''.]]
The Atrisi system was introduced in the ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'', a [[1989]] supplement written by [[Greg Gorden]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, the name of the system was in one instance misspelled as "Artisian system,"<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> whereas the entry of the original [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] for the Galactic Empire, which was published at some point by [[June 24]], [[2001]], introduced the alternate name "Atrisian system."<ref name="DB" /> In the Appendix section of the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''<ref name="TEA" /> and in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book,<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> as well as on galactic maps included in ''The Essential Atlas''<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', the Atrisi system was referred to by the name of<ref name="EGTW" /> its principal planet,<ref name="IS2" /> Kitel Phard.<ref name="TEA" />

When writing ''The Essential Atlas'', the authors [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] placed the planet Atrisia in the Core Worlds region of the galaxy due to previously published sources noting the planet's antiquity and its cultural importance to the wider galaxy.<ref name="Blog" /> However, they also placed it on the very frontier of that region as part of grid square J-12&mdash;near the border of the explored galactic territories.<ref name="TEA" /> This was done intentionally to make Atrisia seem a more exotic location and to provide the authors of future ''[[Star Wars]]'' media with interesting storytelling possibilities.<ref name="Blog" />

"[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine, had previously placed the Atrisi system in the [[Harron sector/Legends|Harron sector]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it was considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> Ultimately, ''The Essential Atlas'' overrode the ''Voyages SF'' 13 placement by establishing that the Atrisi system, and therefore Atrisia, was situated outside of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="TEA" /> in which the Harron sector was later placed.<ref name="Expansion">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}}</ref> ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on StarWars.com<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> featured the first appearance of the Atrisi system.<ref name="AoI" />
